payload.friendly_name: Opt-in hosted drain and ledger flags
payload.purpose_context: Server-side Team Kitty development is frozen. Operators need config.yaml switches that keep the local execution-state ledger available for the upcoming local dashboard while turning the live drain to Zeitgeist off by default, and the shipped build must stop pointing at the live team.spec-kitty.ai endpoint unless an operator configures it (issue #4971).
payload.purpose_tldr: Make every hosted (Team Kitty / Zeitgeist) interaction an explicit, config-based opt-in so a fresh install never talks to a live server.

payload.question: Where does the drain flag live?

payload.final_answer: Both: repo .kittify/config.yaml hosted.drain AND personal global activation (config.toml [hosted] drain). Effective only when both are on; either off/absent => off.

payload.question: What does the ledger flag gate?

payload.final_answer: Option (c): automatic refresh of the gitignored derived execution-state projection under .kittify/derived/<mission>/ after each lane transition; never the lane ledger, its commit, status.json, decisions/, run journal or kitty-ops.

payload.question: Behaviour with no configured hosted endpoint?

payload.final_answer: Explicit hosted commands stop with setup guidance naming SPEC_KITTY_SAAS_URL and config.toml [sync].server_url; automatic paths stay silent.
Keep [sync].server_url; rename deferred to a follow-up issue.

payload.question: Which user-global config.toml holds the personal drain activation?

payload.final_answer: Runtime root config.toml (get_runtime_root().base, ~/.spec-kitty on POSIX, SPEC_KITTY_HOME-overridable) as [hosted] drain — co-located with [sync].server_url and hosted credentials.

payload.question: How does the upgrade treat machines logged in against the implicit packaged default?

payload.final_answer: Backfill: the migration writes [sync].server_url from the stored session issuer_url when no endpoint is configured; a prior login counts as explicit opt-in. Drain stays off.

Operator surface (moments drain), ADR, docs, changelog

Migration opt-in (retired target delete + D-6 session backfill) and remaining default-URL test re-pins
Endpoint opt-in: no packaged fallback in resolver, explicit vs automatic caller split
